$Comment: What every lesson on the Mastery Trainer's board pays in essence: a handful of Essence of Life,
rolled between Count and CountMax on each collect. Expected marks it as the wage the player is owed
for the lesson, so a surface that tells the two apart shows it as ordinary pay, never a lucky find.
Standing with the trainer and the Master's lessons' mastery point ride each lesson's own Rewards,
so the lesson card shows them. Retune the essence here and every lesson follows; a pack adds a roll
of its own with a file that names this table in ContributesTo.
Name: Mmo_Mastery_Lesson_Pay
